source: FIGURES.md pass, September 2026, run on sources 3 to 6. Sources 1 and 2 (Ahrefs matching terms on 'grime artists', also_talk_about) were not run: the owner asked for no new Ahrefs calls (2026-09-22). Source 3 is the owner-supplied People Also Ask, which names Stormzy and asks for famous artists and songs.
note: Source 4, the consensus lists: Wikipedia's early contenders for the first grime record, Time Out 'A brief history of grime', Museum of Youth Culture 'Time of Grime', DMY 'The 10 best Lord of the Mics clashes, according to Jammer'. Source 5, the originators: Wikipedia 'Grime music', 'Boy in da Corner', 'Lord of the Mics', 'Form 696', Emma Warren's RBMA feature on Wiley (2015), Martin Clark's Hyperdub interview with Wiley (2003). Source 6, the catalogue: 705 of 62,877 sets tagged grime; most frequent artists Oneman (11), Spooky (11), Madam X (10), Logan Sama (9), Grandmixxer (8). Every embed below passed YouTube oEmbed on 2026-09-22 and is from the label's, the artist's, VEVO or the Topic channel.
